meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能扫描蛋白序列找出 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T 模式),预测 O-糖基化热点,给出增删糖基化位点的突变序列,并整理分析摘要。还会介绍 NetOGlyc、GlyConnect 等外部工具的用法。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白序列并要求分析糖基化,或讨论抗体工程、治疗性蛋白设计、疫苗抗原设计等糖蛋白工程话题时,会接管处理。

say.text: 请扫描这段蛋白序列的 N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude 会列出各位点位置、motif 与序列上下文。

say.text: 这是 IgG1 Fc 序列,把第297位天冬酰胺改成谷氨酰胺。
say.note: 返回去掉该糖基化位点后的突变序列。

say.text: 用启发式方法预测这条蛋白的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: 会按局部 S/T 密度给出候选位点。

howto.what_en: Claude can scan protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons, predict O-glycosylation hotspots from local Ser/Thr density, add or remove glycosylation sites by mutation, and summarize findings. It also describes external tools such as NetOGlyc and GlyConnect.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user supplies a protein sequence for glycosylation analysis, or discusses topics like antibody engineering, therapeutic protein design, or vaccine antigen design.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Lists positions, motifs and sequence contexts.

say_en.text: Change Asn 297 to Gln in this Fc sequence to remove that site.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots with the heuristic method.
say_en.note: Outputs candidate sites by local S/T density.
